tokens.title: Create tokens
tokens.description: Manage credentials for the shorten API and review each token’s usage.
tokens.create_help: Give this token a name that identifies the application using it.
tokens.name: Application name
tokens.invalid_name: Enter a name between 1 and {count} characters.
tokens.secret_help: Copy this secret to your application now. It is shown only here.
tokens.copy_failed: Select the token to copy it manually.
tokens.rotate_help: This immediately invalidates the current secret. Update your application with the new one to resume creating links.
tokens.revoke_help: This immediately disables the token. Links already created and usage history are retained.
tokens.empty: You have no create tokens yet.

application.conflict: The allowed URLs changed while you were editing. Reload the saved list before saving.
application.title: Application Links
application.description: Choose where the application token can create short links.
application.help: Enter one HTTPS URL per line. An origin allows every path. End a path with a slash to allow paths under it. An empty list blocks new application links.
application.invalid_url: Line {line} must be an HTTPS origin or path without credentials, a query, or a fragment.
application.load_failed: Could not load the allowed URLs.
application.save_failed: Could not save the allowed URLs.

migration_gate.failed_description: Your links are unavailable until the KV to D1 migration completes.

links.preview_mode_tip: The preview mode link is valid for up to 5 minutes.
links.no_filtered_results: No links match the current filters.

form.url_description: Enter a complete URL, such as https://example.com. Maximum {max} characters.
form.url_invalid: URL format is invalid. Enter a complete URL, such as https://example.com.
form.url_too_long: URL is {length} characters long, but the limit is {max}.
form.tags_limit: You can add up to 10 tags.
form.tag_too_long: Tags can be up to 32 characters.
form.expiration_description: The link stops redirecting after it expires and can be restored by editing it.
form.expired_recovery: This link has expired. Set a new future expiration date or clear it to restore the link.
form.redirect_with_query_description: Append query parameters from the short link to the destination URL. Overrides global setting.
form.cloaking_description: Show your short link in the browser address bar instead of the destination URL. May not work for sites that block iframe embedding. Cannot be combined with reverse proxy.
form.unsafe_description: Show a warning page before redirecting. Visitors must confirm to continue.
form.password_description: Require a password to access this short link.
form.og_title_placeholder: Leave empty to use URL hostname
form.image_upload_hint: Click or drag to upload image
form.utm_description: Build UTM parameters locally and append them to the destination URL.
form.utm_invalid_url: Enter a valid URL to preview and apply UTM parameters.
form.proxy_description: Transparently proxies content from the destination URL without a 301/302 redirect. Ideal for subscriptions and APIs. Cannot be combined with link cloaking.

delete.title: Delete {slug}?
delete.description: This permanently deletes the link and cannot be undone.
